mutations.contract: A browser runner that ends -- by Ctrl-Break, by a throw, by process.exit -- leaves no Chrome running: its browser process is already gone at the instant its node exits, and on the two graceful paths it exited 0 because something CLOSED it rather than the exit handler killing it.
mutations.note: Drops the signal handler's close and exits straight away. The exit handler still kills the tree, so Chrome is gone either way -- what reddens is the exit code: a killed browser exits 1, a closed one 0.

mutations.contract: A browser runner that ends -- by Ctrl-Break, by a throw, by process.exit -- leaves no Chrome running: its browser process is already gone at the instant its node exits, and on the two graceful paths it exited 0 because something CLOSED it rather than the exit handler killing it.
mutations.note: Drops the exit handler, the only thing that can close a browser a process.exit() leaves open. Chrome then dies 50-365 ms later on its own, as its DevTools pipe closes -- which is why the check is 'gone at the instant node exits' and not 'gone a few seconds later', which this would pass.
